verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a broad REST API (accounts, cards, transactions, categories, statements, treasury, AR/invoices, customers, webhooks, payments/recipients) plus OAuth2 and an official CLI mirroring most of these resources, and docs explicitly cater to AI agents via llms.txt and MCP. However several flagship UI features lack confirmed API/CLI equivalents (AI bill-pay automation, receipt auto-attach, QuickBooks/Xero AI sync, universal search, cashback handling), and the hosted MCP server is read-only (31 get/list tools, zero write actions), so full UI-to-API parity for agent-driven actions is not demonstrated. missing for 10: confirmed write-capable API/CLI parity for bill-pay AI automation, receipt auto-attachment, QuickBooks/Xero sync, universal search, and write actions via MCP (currently read-only)
